title: Informed Consent for Human Subjects
shortDescription: Basic Information of Research Project - An Experimental Study of Visual Perceptions of Edited Images. The study takes about 45-50 minutes per person.
procedureSteps: You will skim a set of 15 photographs—you have about one minute to view all of them.
You will then complete a short Pac-Man-style game (about two minutes)—please focus on the game only during that break.
You will skim 15 images again (a modified version of the set) for about one minute.

After that, you will complete a short set of questions about the first image set in a group of four: discuss what you saw in the chat box and then answer individually (no group consensus required). Each question has 2 minutes for discussion.
The study will end with a short post-study questionnaire.
consentText: 1) This project is conducted solely for research. 2) Purpose: to study how people perceive and process original and edited visual content as digitally edited media becomes more common. 3) Expected participation time is about 45-50 minutes. 4) Possible inconvenience: slight confusion or discomfort after viewing edited versions of previously seen images. 5) Expected benefit: +10 friendship points with the friend who recruited you. 6) Personal information collected for experiment administration includes name, age, gender, and education; records are kept for 2 months after study completion and then discarded. 7) Participation is voluntary; you may refuse or withdraw at any time without discrimination, and if you withdraw, your study data will be discarded. 8) Malicious or intentionally inaccurate responses are not allowed; contaminated data may be excluded. If you have questions, discomfort, or any research-related damage concerns, please contact the research team listed above.
baselinePhaseInstructions: The following images are similar to everyday, news, or documentary-style scenes. Browse each scene naturally. Swipe the screen or use the buttons to move between images. You have about one minute on this screen; when that time runs out, the study advances to the next step automatically—you cannot stay longer or pause this block.
conditionPhaseInstructions: The following images are modified versions of the first image set—the same scenes, reworked for this second pass. Browse each scene naturally. Swipe the screen or use the buttons to move between images. You have about one minute on this screen; when that time runs out, the study advances to the next step automatically—you cannot stay longer or pause this block.
memoryPhaseInstructions: Each line below goes with a corresponding image from the first viewing block. For each item, choose Agree / Disagree / Not sure, then rate how confident you are on a scale of 1–7.
